items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: since the Boris Vian, since let’s say the 50s, they started to have like the North Pole and the South Pole.

ctx.x: And so you were born in 1962 in the southwest of France. Can you describe the jazz scene at that time when you grew up in that region?

In my city and basically all the cities let’s say in the big southwest of France, you had the two clans. And I escaped from both of them. On one side you had what they called the traditional Hot Club de France, would tend to be very conservative at that time; and on the other side you had, how we say, public places. When I say public I mean like they’re an institution like the Ministry of Culture, and at that time in France since the Boris Vian, since let’s say the 50s, they started to have like the North Pole…
Dixieland, New Orleans, kind of beboppers.
